name: arxiv-source-first
description: Read an arXiv paper from the authors' own LaTeX rather than OCR-ing its PDF. Fetches the e-print source, extracts every display equation with its label, environment and enclosing proposition, renders each to MathML via a Rust pulldown-latex tool, and validates usability by compiling each formula with a real TeX engine. Includes the ground-truth measurement showing OCR of the same paper reaches 0.948 mean similarity but only 80% compile rate.
